intro: {{nameA}} and {{nameB}} both offer {{course}} in Jaipur, Rajasthan, but they are not the same institution. This page compares recorded fees, placements and admission routes from our database, and flags a fee figure that looks incomplete in {{year}}.

Jaipur Engineering College & Research Centre vs JECRC University is an older engineering college compared with a private university that shares a similar name. Do not treat the two campuses as one brand with one fee.

sections.heading: Jaipur Engineering College & Research Centre vs JECRC University for B.Tech: which is better in 2026
paragraphs: Choose JECRC University if you want the higher recorded 2023 figures on this page, at an average of ₹7 lakh and a highest of ₹52 lakh, and a JEE Main route into a university campus.

Choose Jaipur Engineering College & Research Centre if you want the older engineering college and have confirmed its official fee. Our recorded tuition of ₹20,187 a year looks too low for a private Jaipur college and may be a semester, category or outdated figure.

sections.heading: Fees: what our records show
paragraphs: JECRC University's recorded B.Tech tuition on this page ranges from about ₹1.39 lakh to ₹2.20 lakh a year, depending on the programme. An alumni-fee row of ₹10,000 also appears; that is not the programme tuition.

Jaipur Engineering College & Research Centre has recorded tuition of ₹20,187 a year. We do not treat that as a confirmed annual B.Tech fee. Check the college's official circular and the REAP or management-quota notice before you budget.

sections.heading: Placements compared
paragraphs: Both sides have a recorded 2023 year, so the figures can be read together more fairly than on many other comparisons.

JECRC University's 2023 figures are an average package of ₹7 lakh and a highest package of ₹52 lakh. Jaipur Engineering College & Research Centre's 2023 figures are an average of ₹5 lakh and a highest of ₹10 lakh. These are historical outcomes, not a salary promise.

sections.heading: Admission and eligibility
paragraphs: Jaipur Engineering College & Research Centre lists RPET on this page, a name still used for older Rajasthan engineering admissions. Current state counselling is generally through REAP, often using JEE Main or Class 12 marks.
JECRC University lists JEE Main. Confirm the current REAP brochure and each official admissions page for the test that actually applies this year.

sections.heading: Location and campus
paragraphs: Both campuses are in Jaipur, Rajasthan, but they are separate institutions with similar names. Visit the exact campus you have been offered a seat at.
If you already plan to stay in Jaipur, the choice is about college versus university, official fees and the 2023 records, not a change of city.

sections.heading: Verdict: who should pick which college
paragraphs: On the data we can trust, JECRC University is the clearer side: recorded year tuition in the ₹1.39–2.20 lakh band and stronger 2023 figures.
The engineering college may still suit you, but only after you have confirmed its official fee. Do not budget from the ₹20,187 row alone.
Neither side has an NIRF Engineering rank on this page. Use official placement reports and the correct campus name when you decide.

faqs.question: Which is better in 2026, JECRC College or JECRC University, for B.Tech?
faqs.answer: They are separate institutions. JECRC University has recorded 2023 figures of a ₹7 lakh average and a ₹52 lakh highest package, and tuition around ₹1.39–2.20 lakh a year. The engineering college has lower 2023 figures and a recorded tuition of ₹20,187 that we do not treat as confirmed.

faqs.question: Are Jaipur Engineering College & Research Centre and JECRC University the same college?
faqs.answer: No. They share a similar name and are both in Jaipur, but they are different institutions with different recorded fees and placement figures. Check the exact campus on your offer letter.

faqs.question: What are the recorded B.Tech fees for the two JECRC campuses?
faqs.answer: JECRC University's recorded tuition is about ₹1.39 lakh to ₹2.20 lakh a year. The engineering college shows ₹20,187 a year in our records, which may be incomplete or outdated. Confirm both official circulars.

faqs.question: Which exams do they accept?
faqs.answer: The engineering college lists RPET, an older label; current Rajasthan counselling is generally through REAP. JECRC University lists JEE Main. Check the current official notices.

faqs.question: How do placements compare?
faqs.answer: Both have recorded 2023 figures. JECRC University shows an average of ₹7 lakh and a highest of ₹52 lakh. The engineering college shows an average of ₹5 lakh and a highest of ₹10 lakh. These are historical figures, not a guarantee.
